title: feat(studio): lookup picker config in the object field designer
body:
## Why

A lookup / master_detail field's picker configuration (which field labels each candidate, which records are even selectable, dependent-lookup links) lived **only in the raw JSON / 源码 tab** — the object field inspector showed just the target object + relationship name. This is the last "usable but not user-friendly" gap from the inspector audit.

## What

A structured **"Picker config"** section in the field inspector, rendered for `lookup` / `master_detail` / `tree` types, with every field choice bound to the **referenced object's live schema**:

- **Display field / Description field** → field pickers over the referenced object (`displayField`, `descriptionField`).
- **Selectable records** → a structured **`lookupFilters`** editor: rows of `field` + `operator` (eq/ne/gt/lt/gte/lte/contains/in/notIn) + `value` (`in`/`notIn` take a comma-separated list). This is the form the runtime **`LookupField` actually honours** (it reads `lookupFilters`, not the legacy `referenceFilters` strings — confirmed in `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`), so it's structured field/operator/value, **not** CEL — no condition-compiler needed.
- **Depends on** → dependent-lookup links to other fields on the **same record** (`dependsOn`), picked from the host object's fields. This is the formal "$source"-style dependency.
- **Picker page size** (`lookupPageSize`) + **Allow quick-create** (`allowCreate`).

All controls degrade to free-text / empty states when the target object is unset or its catalog can't load. The referenced object's field catalog is loaded via `useObjectFields(reference)` inside a child component, so the parent inspector's hook order is unaffected.

> Note: spec has no `sortField` for lookups — the cheap field-name pickers are `displayField` + `descriptionField`.

## Test plan
- `ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx`: new cases — picker config renders for a lookup field (display/description/selectable-records/depends-on/quick-create), is absent for non-lookup fields, adds a structured `lookupFilters` row via `onPatch`, and reads an existing structured filter. **16/16 pass.**
- Local: app-shell `tsc --noEmit` ✅ (27/27 turbo tasks).
- Browser-verified on the HotCRM showcase backend: opening `crm_opportunity` → the `Account` (crm_account) lookup field shows the full Picker config section; the empty filter state interpolates the reference ("every crm_account record is selectable"); field pickers bind to the referenced object's fields (same proven `useObjectFields` + combo as the dashboard/dataset pickers). No console errors.
